49f8caddd66df3b2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اجال للمختبرات عن فني أجهزة طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، وتحديداً في ضرما. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان الكفاءة التشغيلية ودقة الأداء للأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية، من خلال تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى فني الأجهزة الطبية مسؤولية تنفيذ مجموعة من المهام لضمان استمرارية العمل في المختبر والالتزام بمتطلبات الجودة والسلامة. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: تنفيذ الصيانة الدورية والوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية وفقًا لخطط الصيانة المعتمدة. تشخيص الأعطال الفنية وإجراء الإصلاحات اللازمة للأجهزة المخبرية. فحص الأجهزة والتأكد من سلامة تشغيلها وكفاءتها قبل إعادتها للاستخدام. متابعة أعمال المعايرة والتحقق من دقة القياسات بالتنسيق مع الجهات المختصة. توثيق أعمال الصيانة والإصلاح والمعايرة والاحتفاظ بسجلات الصيانة. متابعة قطع الغيار والمواد اللازمة للصيانة ورفع طلبات توفيرها عند الحاجة. التنسيق مع الموردين والشركات المصنعة لإجراء الإصلاحات المتخصصة عند الضرورة. الالتزام بإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية أثناء أعمال الصيانة. الإبلاغ عن الأعطال المتكررة والمشكلات الفنية واقتراح الحلول المناسبة لتقليل توقف الأجهزة. التعاون مع فريق المختبر لضمان جاهزية الأجهزة واستمرارية العمليات المخبرية. التأكد من تطبيق تعليمات التشغيل والصيانة الصادرة عن الشركات المصنعة. الالتزام بسياسات الجودة والإجراءات التشغيلية المعتمدة في المختبر. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال صيانة الأجهزة الطبية أو ما يعادلها. يجب أن يكون المرشح قادراً على تشخيص الأعطال الفنية وإصلاحها بكفاءة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، ضرما، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة مختبرية. يتطلب الدور التنسيق المستمر مع فريق المختبر والجهات الخارجية لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة. الالتزام بالجودة والسلامة يجب على شاغل الوظيفة الالتزام الصارم بمتطلبات الجودة والسلامة المهنية، بما في ذلك تطبيق تعليمات التشغيل والصيانة الصادرة عن الشركات المصنعة والالتزام بسياسات الجودة والإجراءات التشغيلية المعتمدة في المختبر. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

497b88bb42678f62.description: About SARA Group SARA Group operates with a commitment to genuine communication and authentic behaviors, fostering collaboration and growth. The company values continuous improvement and supports its employees in achieving significant accomplishments. This approach underpins a supportive environment focused on collective success. The Role of Legal Counsel SARA Group is seeking a Legal Counsel to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is critical for safeguarding the Group's legal and commercial interests and ensuring compliance with Saudi laws and regulations. The Legal Counsel will provide practical legal guidance to management and business functions, manage litigation and debt recovery, and oversee legal matters across commercial, corporate, and employment areas. The position requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Provide practical legal advice to senior management and internal departments on commercial, corporate, regulatory, and employment matters under Saudi Arabian law. Collaborate with the Collections Department to review overdue customer accounts, assess legal documentation, and evaluate recovery options. Prepare and issue formal legal notices and demand letters, and draft settlement agreements and payment rescheduling arrangements. Manage legal proceedings, including preparing statements of claim, defense memoranda, and appeals, and represent the company before Commercial, General, and Labor Courts and quasi-judicial authorities. File, monitor, and follow up on lawsuits, attending court hearings in person or remotely. Manage enforcement proceedings through the Najiz platform and Enforcement Courts, including applications for executable instruments, court judgments, asset attachments, and travel ban orders. Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements, such as client and vendor contracts, credit facility agreements, and non-disclosure agreements (NDAs). Ensure contractual terms and conditions protect the Group against financial exposure, payment defaults, and commercial disputes. Monitor changes in Saudi laws and regulations, including the Companies Law, Civil Transactions Law, and Labor Law, and advise on their implications. Support HR on employment-related legal matters, including contracts, bylaws, investigations, disciplinary actions, and terminations. Represent the company in employment-related disputes before amicable settlement offices and Labor Courts. Oversee corporate legal documentation and records, including Commercial Registrations (CRs), partners' resolutions, powers of attorney (POAs), licensing, and intellectual property protection. Work with Finance, Collections, HR, and business stakeholders to identify legal risks, strengthen internal controls, and promote compliance. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in law, with a valid legal license and eligibility to practice and represent companies before judicial authorities in Saudi Arabia. 2-5 years of practical experience in commercial litigation, debt recovery, enforcement procedures, and corporate legal advisory within the Saudi market. Strong working knowledge of Saudi legal frameworks, particularly the Companies Law, Civil Transactions Law, and Labor Law. Hands-on experience with the Najiz platform, Enforcement Courts, promissory notes, executable instruments, and court proceedings. Demonstrated experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial contracts, settlement agreements, legal notices, and litigation documents. Experience handling employment-related legal matters, including labor disputes, investigations, disciplinary actions, and terminations. Strong understanding of corporate governance, regulatory compliance, commercial licensing, and corporate documentation. Required Skills Excellent negotiation, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to translate complex legal matters into practical business recommendations. High level of integrity, sound judgment, and attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple legal cases and priorities independently. Benefits and Development Access to eLearning, educational programs, and personalized development plans. Structured career journeys supported by an AI-driven talent management system. On-demand mental health coaching and perks supporting work-life balance and resilience. Participation in SARA Cares initiatives focused on education and human-centered benefits.

4932f40ce470f505.description: Director Medical Operation Center job purpose s to direct the daily medical operations of Qiddiya City on behalf of Medical Operations, ensuring that contracted medical services are delivered safely, continuously and to the required standard across all city assets. The Director serves as the principal operational interface between Medical Operations, the contracted medical provider, the City Command Unit (CCU) and asset operators. The role provides operational and clinical oversight of the provider's performance, leads medical readiness for assets and events, and directs medical emergency preparedness and incident response. The Director deputizes for the Executive Director, Healthcare Operations, as the organization’s medical subject matter expert, and exercises delegated authority for medical decisions in the Executive Director's absence. Responsibilities: • Run the daily medical operation of Qiddiya City and make sure every asset has medical cover at or above the Medical Minimum Operating Requirements. • Act as the day-to-day operational counterpart to the contracted medical provider and verify that contracted staffing, equipment and standards are delivered. • Lead the medical interface with the City Command Unit, including dispatch, escalation and incident command arrangements. • Lead medical readiness for assets, new openings and events. • Own the operational side of medical emergency preparedness and act as medical incident commander in major incidents. • Oversee clinical governance of the contracted service, including incident and case review. • Deputize for the Executive Director as Qiddiya's medical subject matter expert. Specific Responsibilities: Daily medical operations: • Own the daily operating picture: which clinics, first aid posts, ambulances and response teams are staffed, equipped and open, against the Medical Minimum Operating Requirements. • Run the daily operations rhythm: start-of-day readiness check, shift handovers, end-of-day report and a weekly operations review. • Decide, within delegated limits, how medical resources are moved between assets when demand, staffing or weather changes. • Advise asset operators on whether medical cover meets the minimum to open, stay open or run an event, and escalate when it does not. • Keep response times, encounter volumes, acuity mix and transfers under live review and act on trends before they become failures. Medical provider liaison and performance: • Act as the day-to-day operational counterpart to the contracted provider's leadership. • Verify on the ground that contracted staffing, skill mix, equipment and vehicles are actually delivered, and record shortfalls the same day. • Raise operational and clinical concerns with the provider, agree corrective actions, and track them to closure. • Supply the contract compliance team with the operational evidence needed for KPI, SLA and invoice verification and for formal notices. • Review the provider's clinical policies, protocols and staff credentials for fitness for the Qiddiya environment, and recommend acceptance or change. • Chair the regular operational meeting with the provider and contribute to the contract governance meetings City Command Unit and dispatch integration: • Be the medical lead into the CCU: supervises: triage, dispatch and escalation protocols for medical incidents. • Make sure medical resources are visible to the CCU in real time and that the CCU can reach a medical decision-maker at all hours. • Review dispatch and response performance with the CCU every month and fix the gaps found. Generic Responsibilities: Asset and event medical readiness • Agree a medical operating plan with each asset, covering cover levels, posts, access routes, extraction from rides and attractions, and transfer pathways. • Support in medical readiness for new asset openings, including pre-opening inspections, drills and sign-off recommendations. • Review medical plans for events and mass gatherings, sized on risk and expected attendance. • Carry out regular site walk-rounds and checks on equipment, drugs storage and AED coverage. • Give asset operators clear, practical medical advice on operational questions such as heat, water, ride-related injury and crowd risk. Emergency preparedness and incident response: • Own the operational side of the city's medical emergency plans, including the mass casualty incident plan, job action cards and surge arrangements. • Act as medical incident commander, or as medical adviser to the incident commander, during major incidents. • Plan and run a yearly program of tabletop and live exercises with the provider, the CCU, assets and external agencies, and close the actions that come out of them. • Support air medical and inter-facility transfer arrangements as they develop. Clinical governance and quality oversight: • Review all serious incidents, deaths, cardiac arrests, critical transfers and guest complaints with a medical element, and make sure the provider investigates them properly. • Lead structured case review with the provider and turn the findings into changes in protocol, training or deployment. • Oversee the quality of encounter and injury data, and use it for capacity planning and prevention. • Monitor compliance with regularity requirements across provider facilities and staff. • Contribute to the development and upkeep of Qiddiya's medical standards, including the Medical Minimum Operating Requirements. Leadership, planning and reporting: • Lead and develop the Medical Operations Center team, including hiring, performance management and succession. • Produce the daily, weekly and monthly operational reports for the City Operations leadership. • Contribute operational input to the department's business plan, workforce plan, budget and annual call-off. • Own the operational entries in the department's risk register and keep mitigations moving. • Write and maintain the standard operating procedures for the Medical Operations Center. Generic responsibilities: The Standard QIC responsibilities Experience & Knowledge: • Either medical degree with board certification in Emergency Medicine, or a bachelor’s degree in emergency medicine services or nursing with master’s degree in a relevant field. • For physicians: Board certification in Emergency Medicine (Saudi Board, or an equivalent recognized by the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties). • Preferred: fellowship or subspecialty training in EMS, disaster medicine or prehospital care. • Preferred: a postgraduate qualification in health administration, public health, quality and patient safety, or disaster management. • Physician: Classified as Consultant by the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties, or eligible for that classification on appointment. Non-physician: classified by SCFHS as a senior level in their profession. • Current advanced life support certifications in adult, pediatric and trauma care. • Preferred: formal incident command training, such as the Hospital Incident Command System or Major Incident Medical Management and Support. • At least 10 years of clinical practice after board certification for physicians, or 15 years in EMS or emergency care for non-physicians, including at 5 years in a leadership post with accountability for a service, not only a clinical shift. • Direct experience in EMS or prehospital care in a medical direction, oversight or operational leadership role. • Direct experience in emergency preparedness: writing and exercising major incident or mass casualty plans, and holding a command or senior medical role in a real incident or full-scale exercise. • Experience working with a dispatch or command and control center. • Experience holding another organization to account for clinical performance, through a contract, a regulator role, an accreditation role or medical direction of a third-party service. • Working knowledge of Ministry of Health and Saudi Commission for Health Specialties requirements for facility

Liaise with project teams to ensure proper use of Common Data Environment (CDE) platforms and document control procedures. 49dcb8e7170c39a4.description: About the Role Tamer Mölnlycke Care is seeking a Security & Safety Officer to join their team in Makkah, with operations covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time operational role is responsible for executing day-to-day security controls and assigned safety activities to protect people, property, materials, and operations. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Maintain continuous security observation, conduct scheduled patrols, and monitor CCTV screens and alarm systems, reporting any suspicious activity or abnormal conditions. Control and record the entry and exit of employees, visitors, contractors, and vehicles, performing authorized inspections and preventing unauthorized material entry. Verify, record, and report truck and delivery vehicle movements, monitoring incoming and outgoing materials and ensuring proper documentation. Conduct daily checks of fire-pump pressure, LEL gas-monitoring panels, fire extinguishers, emergency exits, and first-aid boxes, escalating any deficiencies. Issue work permits as authorized, follow up on permitted work, and monitor contractor compliance with site rules and PPE requirements. Support emergency drills, evacuation exercises, and alarm responses, including monitoring security, fire, and emergency notification systems. Observe chemical storage, waste segregation, and general housekeeping conditions during patrols, reporting any concerns or deficiencies. Monitor and coordinate the entry and movement of water/sewage tankers, meal delivery vehicles, and other service providers, maintaining required records. Prepare accurate daily security reports, maintain various security registers, and ensure clear shift handovers. Participate in site observation and incident prevention programs, deliver toolbox talks, and support briefings for visitors and contractors. Internal and External Relationships The Security & Safety Officer will collaborate internally with the EHSS Lead, Production & Operations, Engineering & Maintenance, Warehouse & Logistics, Human Resources, Reception/Administration, and other department representatives for various operational and emergency coordination tasks. Craft comprehensive warranty policies and procedures aligned with Stellantis guidelines, industry standards, and regulatory requirements. Distribute bi-monthly warranty parts scrap lists and monitor parts removal at branches. Administer the warranty claim process, ensuring timely processing and adherence to standards. Leverage data analytics to identify trends in warranty claims and assess program effectiveness. Ensure efficient follow-up on outstanding warranty claims to expedite resolution and minimize payment delays. Implement a tracking system for warranty parts using tagging methods. Conduct regular internal warranty audits quarterly to assess compliance and safeguard program integrity. Financial and Documentation Management Negotiate with parts suppliers to secure favorable pricing for warranty repairs. Perform meticulous reconciliation of all warranty receivables with corresponding payments. Collaborate with the finance team to ensure payments are processed within agreed-upon SLAs. Administer the meticulous documentation of all warranty claims, ensuring necessary supporting documentation is included. Conduct thorough reviews of claim histories, repair orders, and technical documentation to determine claim validity and identify root causes. Generate comprehensive monthly reports on key warranty and technical service performance indicators (KPIs). Ensure all warranty-related documentation adheres to relevant regulations and legal requirements. Maintain a comprehensive archive of warranty documentation for future reference and audits. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated understanding of automotive warranty governance and processes. Proficiency in data analysis for identifying trends and assessing program effectiveness. Strong negotiation skills for supplier interactions. Excellent organizational skills for meticulous documentation and reporting. 497a2d272f37eb89.job_title: Applications Quality Assurance & DevOps Senior Specialist
497a2d272f37eb89.description: About the Role Nahdi Medical Co. is seeking an Applications Quality Assurance & DevOps Senior Specialist to join their team in Makkah or Jeddah. This full-time role focuses on ensuring the quality of software products through meticulous testing and quality assurance activities, alongside operating and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and enforcing DevOps compliance. The specialist will be responsible for designing and executing test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on project requirements, collaborating with various teams to validate software functionality. Key Responsibilities Conduct functional, regression, performance, security, and usability testing across all in-scope applications to verify functionality and identify defects. Design, develop, and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on project requirements and risk-based testing priorities. Identify, track, document, and communicate defects using defect tracking tools (JIRA/Xray, Zephyr, TestRail), collaborating with development teams for timely resolution. Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation, including test plans, test cases, scripts, and results, to ensure coverage, traceability, and knowledge transfer. Set up and configure test environments and test data to simulate real-world scenarios for accurate and reliable testing. Adhere to QA standards, quality gates, and mandatory release deliverables defined by the COE (Test Strategy, Test Plan, Execution Report, Defect Summary, Production Readiness Sign-off). Develop and execute automated test scripts using QA frameworks and tools (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, TestNG, Cucumber, Postman, REST Assured) and contribute to the shared automation framework. Embed automated regression suites as mandatory quality gates in CI/CD pipelines, supporting the target of 60%+ automation coverage for critical applications. Operate and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI), including build, test, deployment, and release automation, and enforce the DevOps compliance framework (source control, branching, environment and release management). Monitor and report DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, MTTR) and contribute to monthly DevOps compliance scorecards. Execute application security testing (SAST, DAST, dependency scanning) within CI/CD pipelines, identify and document vulnerabilities, and support remediation tracking with IT Security in line with OWASP Top 10. Support the Segregation of Duties (SoD) exercise by validating access controls, role configurations, and SoD test cases during release validation in coordination with Internal Audit and IT Security. Support audit and compliance readiness (*, ISO 27001) by maintaining test evidence, release documentation, and reconciliation records, and support the integration reconciliation function between different applications and third-party platforms. Contribute to the Application Portfolio Register, lifecycle dashboard, and monthly Application Excellence Scorecard by providing QA, DevOps, release, and security metrics for assigned applications. Collaborate with development teams, product managers, business stakeholders, IT Security, Internal Audit, and COE leadership; participate in Agile ceremonies; promote shift-left testing practices; and continuously improve QA, DevOps, and security processes while staying current with emerging methodologies and tools. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in quality assurance and DevOps. Demonstrated experience in designing and executing test plans, test cases, and test scripts. Proficiency in various types of testing, including functional, regression, performance, and usability testing. Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA/Xray, Zephyr, and TestRail. Familiarity with QA frameworks and automation tools like Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, TestNG, Cucumber, Postman, and REST Assured. Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI). Knowledge of application security testing (SAST, DAST, dependency scanning) and OWASP Top 10. Work Environment This is a full-time position with a work schedule of 5 days a week, with 2 days off. The typical working hours are from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, including a one-hour break. The role is primarily indoors, accounting for 100% of the work environment.

4983abbc43df3cc7.description: About the Role Taj HR is seeking an Interior Designer to join their team. This full-time role involves reviewing, commenting on, and coordinating with external design consultants on interior design (ID) elements for residential apartment and hotel projects. The Interior Designer will report to the Lead Architect and ensure that ID packages are technically sound, consistent with brand standards, coordinated with architectural designs, and delivered on schedule. The position requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Review and provide comments on ID consultant submissions, including concept, schematic, detailed design, and FF&E packages for residential and hotel projects. Follow up with designers to ensure comments are addressed and revisions are incorporated on schedule. Coordinate the integration of ID design with architectural design, under the guidance of the Lead Architect. Verify ID drawings and specifications for consistency with brand and quality standards across projects. Identify and flag ID design decisions that may have implications for cost, programme, or buildability. Coordinate ID scope with architectural, MEP, and joinery/fit-out packages to prevent clashes and gaps. Track ID coordination status across multiple concurrent residential and hotel projects. Support clash detection and design coordination reviews for ID-related items. Manage RFI responses from site on ID matters, in coordination with the Lead Architect. Direct and follow up with external ID consultants on deliverables, revisions, and quality expectations. Review consultant ID submissions for technical quality, completeness, and compliance with the brief. Maintain ID drawing and document registers within Procore. Review tenant and operator ID submissions (*, hotel operator fit-out standards) for compliance with design guidelines. Provide technical input on FF&E and fit-out specifications to ensure operational functionality. Support design-stage feasibility input on ID scope, standards, and typical costs for new projects. Execute other design-related tasks as assigned by the Lead Architect. Reporting and Decision-Making Authority The Interior Designer reports directly to the Lead Architect. This role holds the authority to review ID consultant submissions and issue technical comments. The incumbent can reject ID submissions that do not meet design, brand, or compliance standards, subject to Lead Architect confirmation. Escalation of ID design issues, consultant non-compliance, and coordination risks will be directed to the Lead Architect. Budget-impacting or brand-standard design changes require Lead Architect approval. Performance Measures Achieve 95% or more of ID review comments issued within the agreed turnaround time. Maintain a 90% or higher first-cycle approval rate for ID submissions before onward issue. Ensure zero brand or quality-standard non-compliance findings attributable to ID review. Contribute to a reduction in ID-related RFIs and change orders during construction and fit-out. Ensure 100% of ID drawing and document registers are current in Procore. Working Relationships Internal collaborations include working closely with the Lead Architect, Construction Services, Commercial Manager and Cost Control, and Leasing and Property Management. External interactions will involve interior design and FF&E consultants, hotel operators and tenants, and contractors. Work Environment The role is primarily office-based (80%) during standard working hours, with approximately 20% dedicated to site visits as business needs require.

Coordinate with the restaurant team to ensure smooth guest flow and efficient operational processes. Handle guest requests and escalate any concerns to the appropriate team members for resolution. Maintain excellent grooming and personal presentation in alignment with company standards. Required Qualifications and Skills Previous experience in a luxury restaurant, hotel, or high-end hospitality environment is preferred. Strong communication and interpersonal skills are essential. Excellent customer service and guest engagement abilities. A well-presented, professional, approachable, and confident demeanor. Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced, guest-facing environment. Knowledge of luxury hospitality standards and international guest expectations. 499551550a9a8557.description: About the Role Canonical is seeking Technical Authors to join its teams in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading documentation efforts across various departments, including engineering, business operations, and other areas of the company. The position is open to multiple seniority levels, from Graduate to Senior Staff, with dozens of roles available. This is an opportunity to contribute to setting a high standard for technical documentation within the industry. Role Focus Areas Technical Authors at Canonical can specialize in one of three areas, while also being part of the company's broader documentation practice team: Product-focused: Embedded within a product engineering team, you will develop documentation for specific products or product families, focusing on user needs and the overall user experience. Customer-focused: Working with teams like Field Engineering or Support, you will address documentation challenges for complex Canonical software deployments, understanding real-world product usage. Operations-focused: As part of business teams such as Legal or HR, you will maintain and improve internal documentation, including employee handbooks, and define business communication patterns. Key Responsibilities Create, maintain, and improve software and other forms of documentation. Collaborate with team members to facilitate effective documentation contributions. Influence the development of Canonical products and services through expert user feedback on function and design. Engage with user communities to ensure documentation meets their requirements. Encourage and support community involvement and contributions to documentation. Help standardize content structure, presentation, style, and language across products. Collaborate with documentation peers to advance documentation practices at Canonical. Contribute to the understanding and best practices of documentation as part of a disciplinary team. Candidate Profile and Qualifications Candidates for this role should demonstrate a strong commitment to technical communication and possess relevant technical skills. Experience required for these roles ranges from 0-1 years, depending on the seniority level. Excellent collaboration and communication skills. A strong focus on functional written communication. Background as a technical writer with a programmer's mindset, or a programmer with a history of producing documentation. Record of community engagement in open-source software, documentation, research, or other fields. Understanding of the needs and challenges within open-source software and its communities. Demonstrated technical curiosity and interest in software technology. Demonstrable documentation skills, insight, and enthusiasm. Experience in software development contexts. Familiarity with Linux, command-line operations, Git, Sphinx, and reStructuredText. Holds a BSc/BA degree or equivalent. Ability to travel twice a year for up to two weeks for events. Compensation and Benefits Canonical considers geographical location, experience, and performance in determining compensation. Compensation is reviewed annually, with more frequent reviews for graduates and associates, to acknowledge outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, a performance-driven annual bonus or commission is offered. The company provides additional benefits designed to meet local needs and ensure global fairness.

Support Legionella control through scheduled inspection, cleaning, and disinfection of air conditioning systems. Interpret blueprints, schematics, wiring diagrams, and other technical documentation. 492789f2ef215f05.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث جمعية توافق للإصلاح الأسري بالمدينة المنورة عن أخصائي خدمة اجتماعية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة الممارسات المتخصصة في الخدمة الاجتماعية، وإجراء التحليلات اللازمة للكشف عن التحديات والمشكلات الاجتماعية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف شاغل هذه الوظيفة إلى تحليل التجارب والممارسات في مجال الخدمة الاجتماعية، وتحديد الاحتياجات، والكشف عن المشكلات الاجتماعية، وتقديم المشورة والبرامج المتخصصة لمعالجتها. كما يتضمن الدور إعداد الأبحاث والتقارير لضمان التحسين المستمر للخدمات المقدمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل التجارب والممارسات المتخصصة في مجال الخدمة الاجتماعية، وتقييم مدى الاستفادة منها. إعداد التوصيات والمقترحات لتبني أفضل الأساليب والممارسات الحديثة، ومناقشة كيفية تطبيقها. إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل والاستقصاءات الاجتماعية لتحديد الاحتياجات والكشف عن التحديات والمشكلات الاجتماعية، وتقديم التوصيات اللازمة. تحديد مصادر المعلومات والبيانات عن الحالات الاجتماعية، واختيار الطرق والأدوات المناسبة لجمعها وتنظيمها وإدارتها وتحليلها. تقديم المشورة بشأن التعامل مع المشكلات الاجتماعية مثل البطالة والفقر والإدمان والإجرام وسوء المعاملة. وضع برامج مخصصة لحل المشكلات بطريقة علمية ومنهجية، والتأكد من فعاليتها. إعداد الأبحاث والتقارير عن الوضع الاجتماعي والحالات الموجودة في الدور والمراكز، واقتراح الخطط التحسينية والإصلاحية والتطويرية. رفع التقارير إلى الرئيس المباشر، وضمان حفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الخدمة الاجتماعية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل الاجتماعية. مهارات قوية في جمع البيانات وتنظيمها وتحليلها. القدرة على تقديم المشورة ووضع البرامج العلاجية. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي الخدمة الاجتماعية بدوام كامل ضمن فريق جمعية توافق للإصلاح الأسري في المدينة المنورة، ويسهم في تقديم الدعم والحلول للمشكلات الاجتماعية في المنطقة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

49650f2f923bce67.description: About the Role Echelon is seeking a Senior Responsible Owner (SRO) for Customer Excellence to lead the company’s Customer Excellence Program. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, involves owning the customer 360, which provides a single view of each customer. The SRO will define how AI agents and account teams collaborate to ensure consistent and accurate customer engagement. The position reports directly to the Chief Operating Officer and requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain the customer 360, ensuring one record and one account plan per customer, kept current by AI agents and approved by the account owner. This includes organizational details, decision-makers, system and data landscapes, AI maturity, contracts, projects, pipeline, delivery history, and value delivered. Manage customer data quality within CRM and delivery tools, defining what is captured, by whom, when, who can edit it, and how account teams and pods utilize it. Analyze and interpret customer strategies, budgets, AI priorities, leadership changes, and buying cycles, briefing account teams and strategists before key meetings. Measure customer health through satisfaction metrics across accounts, feedback after engagements, and early warnings for at-risk accounts. Run the weekly cadence for accounts, including account reviews, executive touchpoints, customer events, programs, and their follow-up. Inform leadership through regular customer reviews for the COO and leadership team, detailing successes, challenges, and unaddressed customer requests. Required Qualifications and Skills Customer Record: 6+ years of experience in customer success, account operations, CRM, or customer analytics within a technology or services business. Data Fluency: Proficiency with CRM systems, dashboards, and imperfect data, with the ability to make data useful to others. Rigour: Ability to maintain accurate and current records independently and build sustainable, simple processes. Connector: Demonstrated ability to collaborate across sales, delivery, and leadership, building trust through effective contributions. AI Fluency: Capability to identify AI use cases, develop agentic workflows for the Customer Excellence Program, and determine human review points. Advantageous Experience Sector Knowledge: Experience with customers in sectors where Echelon operates, such as government, energy, financial services, or healthcare. CRM Platforms: Hands-on administration experience with a major CRM platform. Work Environment and Compensation This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves travel to customer sites and events across the Kingdom. The compensation package includes a base salary, housing, transport, and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity program. Specific terms will be shared at the offer stage.

4927cee67ffadb8a.description: About Rixos Hotels Rixos Hotels is a global leader in hospitality, committed to supporting employee growth and learning. The company offers opportunities for individuals to find roles that align with their aspirations. Rixos Murjana, a new property in Saudi Arabia, is a 275,000 square meter all-inclusive resort designed to offer indulgence, relaxation, and adventure, redefining hotel stays in the Kingdom. The Role of P&C Coordinator Rixos Hotels is seeking a P&C Coordinator for its operations in Makkah, specifically in King Abdullah Economic City and Makkah. This full-time position reports directly to the Director of Human Resources. The P&C Coordinator is responsible for providing efficient, personalized, courteous, and timely service to all colleagues, supporting the smooth daily operation of the People & Culture Department. The role involves coordinating various Human Resources functions while ensuring compliance with hotel standards, policies, procedures, and applicable legal requirements. Key Responsibilities Maintain and update candidate databases and CV records for recruitment. Assist in the recruitment and hiring of rank-and-file employees, coordinating the entire process from interviews to arrivals. Ensure accuracy and completeness of recruitment documentation and candidate records. Coordinate with hotel departments on recruitment needs and hiring activities. Liaise with the PRO and external agencies for employee visa applications and arrangements. Coordinate new employee arrivals and ensure all joining arrangements are completed. Manage employee joiner and leaver administration, maintaining accurate and confidential employee files, records, and databases. Monitor and track annual and sick leave accruals. Coordinate employee-related activities across all hotel departments. Support the implementation and evaluation of HR practices to improve departmental efficiency. Establish and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues and coordinate employee relations functions. Provide comprehensive administrative support to the Director of Human Resources, handling confidential matters, managing correspondence, and scheduling. Prepare letters, memorandums, reports, and other documents using various applications. Maintain organized electronic and physical filing systems. Prepare, maintain, and update HR reports, records, and departmental databases, including the Management Information System (MIS). Conduct regular audits to ensure records are accurate and up to date. Ensure compliance with hotel policies, procedures, operational standards, and applicable legal requirements, including health, hygiene, security, safety, and fire regulations. Qualifications and Experience A Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline is preferred. Previous experience in Human Resources or administration is required. A minimum of one year of experience in a similar role is required. Work Environment and Expectations The P&C Coordinator will work in a collaborative environment, supporting colleagues and contributing to departmental objectives. The role requires maintaining familiarity with company documentation and operational standards, adhering to service standards, and completing assigned tasks accurately and efficiently. Professionalism, accountability, and commitment to personal and professional development are expected.

49fb599aa1dbe365.description: About the Role Lobo Management is seeking a Sales Manager specializing in Small Domestic Appliances (SDA) or Major Domestic Appliances (MDA) Sales. Present company products and educate consultants, partners, and end-customers on the advantages of products, including those developed through partnerships. 496c03cb63584d11.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الخدمات الاستشارية السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية عن رسام معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تحويل المسودات والتصاميم الهندسية إلى رسومات معمارية وإنشائية دقيقة، سواء يدويًا أو باستخدام البرمجيات المتخصصة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الرسم المعماري. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قراءة وتفسير مسودات المخططات والتصاميم المعمارية والرسوم الإنشائية بالتنسيق مع المهندسين المختصين. رسم وتحرير المخططات المعمارية والإنشائية والرسوم التنفيذية يدويًا باستخدام أدوات الرسم المخصصة. إعداد المخططات الهندسية المعمارية والإنشائية والرسوم التنفيذية باستخدام برمجيات الرسم الهندسي على الحاسوب. تدقيق الرسومات وتقديمها للمهندس المعماري لإعداد النسخ النهائية وفقًا للتوجيهات. طباعة المخططات النهائية باستخدام برامج الحاسوب بالمقياس المطلوب. تصنيف وفهرسة وتوثيق وترتيب وحفظ المخططات الهندسية والمعمارية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الرسم المعماري أو الإنشائي. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والتصاميم الهندسية بدقة. إتقان الرسم اليدوي للمخططات المعمارية. إتقان استخدام برمجيات الرسم الهندسي على الحاسوب. المهارات والكفاءات دقة عالية في التفاصيل والالتزام بالمعايير الهندسية. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة لتصنيف وحفظ الوثائق. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتواصل الفعال مع المهندسين. الالتزام بالمواعيد النهائية للمشاريع. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. يعمل الرسام المعماري ضمن فريق هندسي متخصص، ويساهم في إنجاز المشاريع الهندسية المتنوعة للشركة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة الخدمات الاستشارية السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية.

497917f826995892.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تقنية النانو للمطابخ عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في القطيف، بالمنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على تطوير وتنفيذ سياسات البيع، ومتابعة الأداء، وتقييم النتائج لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. ستتاح الفرصة للمرشح للعمل بدوام كامل والمساهمة في نمو الشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل تطورات السوق لتحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير طرق البيع الفعالة. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل مع العملاء لفهم احتياجاتهم وتحديد المشكلات، ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية. تقييم أداء مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تحليل السوق وتحديد الفرص البيعية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع العملاء والزملاء. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي المبيعات ضمن فريق في القطيف، المنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التفاعل المستمر مع فريق العمل والعملاء. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة تساعد على تحقيق الأهداف المهنية والشخصية. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى شركة رائدة في مجال تقنية النانو للمطابخ. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

49da041b9e2a1245.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سوفيتيل جبل عمر عن موظف استقبال فندق للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإشراف على خدمات الضيوف في مكتب الاستقبال وتنسيقها وتقديمها، بما في ذلك عمليات الحجز وتسجيل الدخول والخروج. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الحفاظ على قائمة الحجوزات وتوفير السجلات الورقية الضرورية. العمل على رفع مستوى خدمة العملاء ورضاهم، ومتابعة المنازعات والشكاوى. ضمان تنفيذ سياسات وإجراءات الفندق. تكوين علاقات تجارية قوية والحفاظ عليها مع أطراف أخرى، مثل وكالات السفر والحجوزات. مراجعة أسعار الفندق وتنظيم الفواتير تبعاً لذلك. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إدارة مهام مكتب الاستقبال بفعالية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع الضيوف والشركاء. بيئة العمل يعمل موظف الاستقبال في فندق سوفيتيل جبل عمر بمدينة مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة فندقية ديناميكية تركز على تقديم خدمة عملاء عالية الجودة. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق سوفيتيل جبل عمر في مكة المكرمة. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

490bf249303b441a.description: About Baker Hughes and the Role Baker Hughes, a global energy technology company, is seeking a Quality Control Supervisor, Manufacturing & Rotating Equipment to join its Industrial and Energy Technology (IET) team in Dammam, Eastern Region. The IET division operates across 120 countries, serving the entire energy value chain and industrial sector with a portfolio that includes rotating equipment, process flow, transmission technology, and lifecycle services. This full-time role is integral to improving the quality of engineering processes within the organization. Role Overview The Quality Control Supervisor will lead and manage a team of quality inspectors, ensuring adherence to company procedures, industry standards, and regulatory requirements. This position involves direct engagement with customers for inspection and closure meetings, as well as collaboration with production teams to maintain operational compliance and efficiency. The supervisor will also be responsible for driving continuous improvement initiatives and addressing quality-related issues. Key Responsibilities Supervise and guide quality inspectors, assigning tasks, monitoring daily activities, and ensuring team productivity. Provide training, coaching, and performance feedback to team members. Ensure compliance with company procedures, industry standards, and regulatory requirements. Attend pre-inspection meetings and manage punch list closure meetings with customers. Ensure the completeness and on-time delivery of quality records according to applicable requirements. Partner with the production team to ensure smooth Cell operations and compliance with all applicable procedures. Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) related to manufacturing quality issues. Monitor quality control metrics for observations/punch lists found during execution phases and take appropriate actions. Drive cross-functional improvement projects of operational processes using lean methods, aiming for flawless execution and elimination of waste tied to metrics such as escaping defects and observations/punch lists. Lead quality Tool Box awareness for the production team. Ensure effective implementation of Quality Control processes. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering. Minimum of 5 years of experience in manufacturing and rotating equipment. Experience leading a team of quality inspectors. Six-Sigma Green Belt Certified. Certified with ISO9001 Lead Auditor/Internal Auditor. Ability to work effectively in a global environment. Required Skills Excellent functional/technical skills. Strong customer focus. Effective communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills. Demonstrated teamwork abilities. Work-Life Balance Baker Hughes supports flexible working patterns to accommodate individual needs. For this role, once assignments are complete, there is generally no requirement to visit the office. Employees can operate from home to perform basic tasks such as completing previous assignment reports or handling mobilization-related aspects before commencing new projects. The company is committed to ensuring a healthy work-life balance for its employees.

49d00aa774215ee1.description: About the Role Nesma & Partners is seeking an experienced Estimation Manager – Mechanical (Oil & Gas) to lead and oversee mechanical estimation activities. This full-time position is based in Al Khobar, Eastern region, and focuses on major Oil & Gas projects. Role Overview The Estimation Manager will be responsible for managing the entire estimation process, from initial tender review through final cost submission. This role requires a strong leader with extensive experience in Oil & Gas EPC projects, possessing deep technical knowledge of mechanical systems, cost estimation, tendering, and commercial evaluation. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage mechanical estimation activities for Oil & Gas projects, ensuring accurate, competitive, and commercially viable cost proposals. Review tender documents, technical specifications, drawings, scope of work, and contractual requirements to identify project needs and potential risks. Develop detailed cost estimates for mechanical works, including piping, pipelines, static and rotating equipment, pressure vessels, tanks, and related Oil & Gas facilities. Prepare and review material take-offs (MTOs), quantity take-offs, Bills of Quantities (BOQs), and detailed cost breakdowns. Coordinate with engineering, procurement, construction, and project management teams to validate technical assumptions and cost estimates. Evaluate subcontractor and supplier quotations, conduct technical and commercial comparisons, and negotiate competitive pricing. Establish estimation strategies, methodologies, cost databases, and benchmarking practices. Identify cost-saving opportunities, risks, and value engineering alternatives. Lead and mentor the mechanical estimation team, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and timely submission of tenders. Ensure all estimates comply with client requirements, project specifications, and company standards. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in mechanical estimation, specifically within Oil & Gas EPC projects. Demonstrated strong technical knowledge of mechanical systems. Proven experience in cost estimation, tendering, and commercial evaluation. Ability to lead and manage estimation teams effectively. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, Eastern region. The role involves working on significant Oil & Gas projects for Nesma & Partners. Application Process Nesma & Partners invites qualified candidates to apply for this role. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

492313ba7d1d9ae0.description: مطلوب: مسؤول مخزون وتوزيع ميداني (نظام RaaS) – الرياض نبحث عن موظف ميداني نشيط، جاد، ومنظم للانضمام إلى فريقنا لمتابعة وتوزيع الأحذية الرجالية الفاخرة على شبكة متاجرنا الشريكة في مدينة الرياض، باستخدام أحدث التطبيقات والتقنيات الرقمية. مدينة العمل الرياض المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الزيارات الميدانية: القيام بزيارات دورية (أسبوعية) للمتاجر الشريكة (RaaS). تدقيق المخزون: إجراء جرد دقيق للمخزون داخل المعارض باستخدام تطبيق الشركة المخصص ومسح الباركود / QR Code. التزويد والتجديد: تسليم البضائع وتجديد المخزون أسبوعياً بالتنسيق مع مسؤولي المتاجر. المتطلبات الأساسية وسيلة التنقل: رخصة قيادة سارية وسيارة خاصة للتنقل بين المتاجر. الخبرة: خبرة لا تقل عن 3 أشهر في مجال التوزيع، الجرد، أو المبيعات الميدانية. المهارات: مهارات تواصل ممتازة وأسلوب احترافي في التعامل مع أصحاب ومسؤولي المعارض. الأمانة والدقة في المواعيد وإدارة الوقت. ماذا نقدم؟ الراتب الأساسي: حد أدنى 2,500 ريال يصل إلى 4,000 ريال شهرياً (يحدد حسب الخبرة والكفاءة). نقل الكفالة: توفر نقل كفالة بعد اجتياز فترة التجربة بنجاح. عمولات تحفيزية: مكافآت إضافية على إنتاج فيديوهات محتوى التواصل الاجتماعي. بدل بنزين / شريحة وقود: تغطية مصاريف الوقود للتنقل الميداني. اتصالات: شريحة جوال مدفوعة الباقة بالكامل من الشركة.

498ad9ba7f0b5f37.description: تبحث شركتنا عن مشرف تدريب للانضمام إلى فريقنا، يمتلك خبرة في تطوير وتنفيذ البرامج التدريبية. ستكون مسؤولاً عن تقييم احتياجات التدريب، وتصميم محتوى الدورة، وتقديم التدريب الفعال للموظفين. إذا كنت شغوفًا بالتعليم والتطوير، ولديك مهارات تواصل ممتازة، فنحن ندعوك للتقديم. المهام والمسؤوليات: * تسجيل بيانات المتدريبن ورفعها بنظام المؤسسة العامة للتدريب التقني والمهني *اجراء متطلبات الترخيص والمتابعة. * تحديد احتياجات التدريب للموظفين ووضع خطط تدريبية فعالة. * تصميم وتطوير مواد تدريبية مبتكرة وجذابة. * تقديم الدورات التدريبية وإدارة جلسات التعلم. * تقييم فعالية البرامج التدريبية وقياس أثرها على أداء الموظفين. * متابعة التطورات الحديثة في مجال التدريب وتطبيق أفضل الممارسات.

495ac12f2b5b8ea8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة سمايا عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال وإعداد برامج الصيانة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات لخطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية وتحديد مساراتها. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. وضع برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات المعمول بها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة ببرامج تشغيل المعدات الكهربائية وتشخيص الأعطال. بيئة العمل يقع مقر هذا الدور في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مجموعة سمايا.

498068827f13bc0b.description: About the Role Leda Fagundes Beauty is seeking a Customer Service Agent to join their team in Riyadh. Manage incoming calls, WhatsApp messages, and general inquiries, providing high-level explanations of treatment categories and routing detailed questions to practitioners. Oversee the booking calendar, including scheduling, rescheduling, confirmations, and reminders for appointments. Handle client check-ins and check-outs, and maintain basic client records. 495d44ff2754f164.description: About the Role moomoo is seeking a Senior Risk Officer to manage daily risk mitigation and monitoring for the firm’s credit, collateral, and operational risk portfolios. This full-time position, based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, focuses primarily on margin lending and financing operations. The Senior Risk Officer will report to the Head of Compliance and ensure all trading accounts comply with local regulatory mandates. Key Responsibilities The Senior Risk Officer will be responsible for a range of duties across risk management, including: Actively tracking internal process failures, validating manual system entries, enforcing dual controls, and logging operational risk incidents. Ensuring no margin transaction occurs without validating mandatory initial and maintenance margin thresholds. Assessing client financial profiles using the internal credit scorecard to assign and review appropriate margin limits. Monitoring daily margin usage, blocking unauthorized limit extensions, and immediately escalating unauthorized breaches to senior management. Verifying that margin trading transactions are restricted from unapproved, highly speculative, or derivative financial instruments. Collateral and Liquidation Management This role involves managing collateral and overseeing liquidation processes to mitigate risk exposure: Evaluating eligible stocks to assign Initial Margin ratios and risk groups, ensuring high-risk or "red-colored" stocks are restricted. Tracking total credit exposure per stock across all client portfolios to prevent excessive single-stock concentration. Recommending and directing forced liquidations for unsettled margin calls, prioritizing assets systematically from high-risk to higher-quality holdings. Operational Risk and Process Controls The Senior Risk Officer will establish and maintain robust operational risk controls: Establishing processes to assess and mitigate risks associated with new products, services, distribution channels, or system enhancements. Sample testing and validating manual entries, correction entries, and account regularizations within core systems. Coordinating with department heads to ensure procedures are updated regularly to include controls for new business processes. Monitoring, investigating, and updating management on significant reportable events such as incidents, complaints, claims, errors, rule breaches, and fraud. Governance and Integrated Reporting This position includes responsibilities for risk governance and reporting: Preparing the annual risk assessment plan and recommending policy adjustments in light of the firm's changing risk appetite. Providing continuous risk identification and mitigation support to business lines and department heads.
